headline: Anthropic shares fall 6% in premarket amid AI selloff as Nvidia, AMD shares drop
detail: This headline confirms a broad "AI selloff" impacting key chip names like Nvidia and AMD. Given your ~90% concentration in tech/chip names, this directly impacts your portfolio, especially leveraged positions. Margin amplifies these drops.
rec: Consider reviewing stops on SMH, SOXL, SMCI, and QQQ. The current market sentiment is highly negative for your core holdings.

headline: Here’s what happened next after previous times the S&P 500 losing streak reached six sessions
